hypotheses.justification: Split on a < b; the displayed proof handles that case. Otherwise b ≤ a, and γd is identically zero: if γd z ≠ 0, hs gives z.1 ≤ b ≤ a, contradicting TransportPrimitive.radial_zero_of_le hγ.continuous hs. This includes a = b. Unfolding weightedSource, normalizeSource, physicalCompact and streamPotential then gives streamPotential = 0, since all integrals have zero integrands. Both stream fields and their divergence are consequently zero by fderiv_zero and zero_div, including at p.1 = 0. No nontriviality assumption on E is needed.
